g.text: A · 2 m terrain → ~13 m pixel: keep the maximum
mean per pixel: not used (it lowers ridges)
6 pixels of ~13 m (zoom 13) · 2 m data: ~40 points per pixel row (not to scale)
B · Search grid: max of the 2 × 2 pixels around each cell center
• zoom = coarsest whose pixels ≤ cell size, at most 13
(true) value, minus (tiles − exact ground) at the start
• every source clamped at −450 m (lowest dry land)
